metadata.capture_purpose: Prove independent controller enrollment and discover the first real environment-binding boundary while ChatGPT iOS remains connected.
metadata.source_classification: target binary plus official live service
metadata.operator_attestation: Owner authorized the bounded real-account probe and attested ChatGPT iOS was connected to the current Mac before the attempt.
metadata.redaction_procedure: Kept all credentials, codes, signatures, raw identifiers and raw bodies in process memory; retained only status codes, field names, counts, pseudonyms and cleanup outcomes.
metadata.secret_scan_result: PASS: no leaks found after fixture and probe write
metadata.cleanup_result: Probe controller DELETE returned HTTP 204 and the independently created key was deleted successfully.

observations.detail: Embedded official app-server returned ChatGPT auth to probe memory only; no credential was printed or persisted.
The target ChatGPT addon loaded but external invocation could not add either Secure Enclave or fallback material to its entitled keychain context; OSStatus -34018.
An independently signed Phase 0 helper used a permanent nonextractable login-Keychain P-256 key. Secure Enclave remained unavailable in this helper context.

adjudication.first_divergence: A newly enrolled controller has zero client-specific environments even though the account-level list contains one online Desktop environment.
adjudication.required_next_evidence: Owner must generate a fresh manual pairing code in ChatGPT Desktop so the newly enrolled probe controller can call the official pair endpoint. A code must be entered directly into the running probe and must never be sent in chat or committed.
